blocks.text: This page tracks the Langley MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $941,800 for a typical home, down 6.2% over twelve months.
Langley benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Langley home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $941,800 in September 2026. That is little changed at −0.7% on the month, little changed at −1.3% over three months, down 2.5% over six months and down 6.2% over the year. Over three years it is down 9.6%, and over five years down 1.9%.
The weakest one-year move in Langley was for an apartment homes at −9.2%; the strongest was a townhouse at −4.4%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,471,100) and an apartment ($525,900) is $945,200, and a townhouse ($802,600) sits $276,700 above the apartment benchmark.
Against the Fraser Valley Board area, where the all-home benchmark was $861,300, Langley is 9.3% above. Over the year the Fraser Valley Board area moved down 7.2% against down 6.2% here.
Of the 8 areas this board reports, Langley ranks 3 by all-home benchmark, with South Surrey & White Rock above it at $990,300 and Cloverdale below it at $921,900.

Detached homes in Langley: benchmark $1,471,100, little changed at −0.6% in a month, down 1.6% in three months, down 2.8% in six months, down 6.7% in a year, down 9.6% in three years and down 2.9% in five. That is 13.2% above the detached benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($1,300,000).

Townhouse homes in Langley: benchmark $802,600, little changed at −0.5% in a month, little changed at −1.3% in three months, little changed at −1.1% in six months, down 4.4% in a year, down 7.5% in three years and up 7.0% in five. That is 7.7% above the townhouse benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($745,300).

Apartment homes in Langley: benchmark $525,900, down 1.5% in a month, down 3.0% in three months, down 5.6% in six months, down 9.2% in a year, down 12.5% in three years and up 3.5% in five. That is 13.9% above the apartment benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($461,800).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Langley?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Langley home was $941,800, with detached at $1,471,100.

faq.q: Are Langley home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Langley is down 6.2% over twelve months and little changed at −1.3% over three months.
